text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Gran 
Alegria invited me to the park. There, we 
saw—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan, Boku-kun! Are you doing well 
today too~?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Ah, Gran-oneechan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hii! Gran-chan. Hello to you too, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We're friends! Alright, let's play! Today, 
my Trainer's with us too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without much of an explanation, Gran 
Alegria pushed me forward, and I ended up 
playing with the children.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending about an hour playing 
hide-and-seek and tag—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, she fell asleep. We'd better wake 
her up before it gets dark.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You really ran around a lot, didn't 
you? Thank you, Trainer♡ See, she's all 
smiles now too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, what a relief! After all, 
nobody wants to see a sad face~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Truth is, this child's father is 
overseas on a business trip, and her 
mother is always working late.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mom's the type who just can't say no. She 
said that whenever someone asks her, she 
ends up taking it on even if it's not her 
job.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we could tell her that this 
child is lonely, I'm sure she would come 
rushing back at the speed of an Umamusume, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, your house is right across the way. 
Still, you shouldn't be alone in the park 
once it gets dark, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because the people who care 
about you will be terribly worried!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! I even have a smartphone 
now, see? Mommy and Daddy told me I can 
call them anytime if I ever get lonely!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
"Still, work is tough, so... I have to be 
patient and hold back."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
They're just kids, so I don't really think 
they need to hold back that much, though~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Your parents surely feel the 
same way.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Besides, rather than talking on the phone, 
I'd really be much happier if you just 
came home early.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If she doesn't get in the way of work, 
you'll be able to come home that much 
sooner... That's what this little girl 
believes."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...'I want to see you as soon as 
possible,' huh..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Gran Alegria gently patted the child's 
head, she began to ponder something—

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're awake!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Alright, let's get going then!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Huh? Where are you going, Big 
Sis?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"To the station, of course! I'm going to 
welcome Mama."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you get even one mile closer, you'll 
get to see them that much sooner, right?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!? Really!? Wow... It's my first time 
going to pick someone up!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My! What a wonderful Love♡Surprise! I have 
her contact info, so I'll shoot her a 
message to get permission!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a great idea, but— I briefly hold 
back the three excited girls.
choice_data_list:
We should check the time to head home 
first.

If you were already planning to work 
overtime—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. Aside from getting 
permission, I have to consider the time as 
well. I'm sorry. I just got way too 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! If I text her saying I'll come 
pick her up, I bet she'll come right back 
home!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
B-But... wouldn't that be selfish of 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We won't know unless we ask! If they say 
no, then next time. If they say okay, then 
yay! Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's so like Gran Alegria to act purely as 
she pleases— just as she always has. Even 
if it felt a little forceful...

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you, I'm back~! I'm so happy 
you came to meet me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's good or bad cannot be known 
without seeing the results. And to see the 
results, one must take action.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the smiles on the child and mother, 
I realized that sometimes, momentum 
matters more than overthinking things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I speak in a low voice so the kids won't 
hear. If I get their hopes up and we can't 
pull it off, it might be getting ahead of 
ourselves—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, let's head straight to 
the office!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just dropping by to say hi shouldn't be a 
problem, right? You can just tell them to 
keep up the good work and head right back!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! That's right. It's not like 
everything is impossible, or that I can't 
do anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"There should at least be time to share 
some love♡ ...As well as how lonely it 
feels."

text_block_list.name: Child's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for making you feel 
lonely...! Mommy will learn to say no! 
Starting tomorrow... no, starting right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria and Loves Only You grin and 
flash peace signs at me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up thinking it's impossible; 
search for what's feasible, look for what 
you can do. I felt like I learned just how 
important that is.
